add_character_to_viser_scene: add a character with joint frames and optional mesh to a viser 3D scene
update_character_in_viser_scene: update all character joint transforms and mesh vertices in a single atomic batch
add_mesh_to_viser_scene: add a solid mesh and hidden wireframe mesh to a viser scene from pymomentum geometry
add_joints_to_viser_scene: add per-joint coordinate frames and bone line segments to a viser scene
add_log_panel_to_viser_gui: add a scrollable HTML log strip to the viser GUI for runtime messages
